title: Figure 28: Implantable neurostimulation device beside a penny and syringe needle
description: Photograph of a tiny cylindrical implantable neurostimulator lying near the tip of a syringe needle, with a U.S. one-cent coin for scale. Caption reads "Figure 28. A New Generation of Implantable Neurostimulation Devices Can Pass Through the Lumen of a Syringe Needle. This device was made at ASU and is powered by ultrasound energy. (Towe et al.)"
